scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run build -w @youscan/shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run build -w @youscan/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @youscan/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @youscan/shared && npm run build -w @youscan/api && npm run build -w @youscan/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @youscan/shared && npm run typecheck -w @youscan/api && npm run typecheck -w @youscan/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @youscan/shared && npm run test -w @youscan/api && npm run test -w @youscan/web
